svg.title: Instruction and paced help
svg.desc: What help is available, and when is it available? Instructional content, the amount or timing of support, and progression across sessions are distinct design choices. Fading is not automatically evidence of learning. Source illustration: Historical equipment, skill and rune choices can be inspected beside controls revealing the current match.
